title: Vietnam veteran on shooting at spooks

tellings.quote: You think you shoot at somebody, you ain't shoot at nothing. Waste your fire out there. Guy in Vietnam told me that.

plain: In Vietnam, firing at these strange figures was a waste of ammunition: you thought you were shooting at somebody, but you hit nothing. Michael Johnson, an Air Force veteran who appears on the show with other veterans who say they were abducted by aliens, tells Michels a man who served in Vietnam told him this. If true, soldiers in that war would have met figures that bullets could not touch.
